headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to carry out the administration's plan to review and cut back federal regulations.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up ways for federal agencies to put the President's regulatory reform agenda into practice. It focuses on how agencies review their existing rules and decide whether to keep, change, or remove them. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to take steps to review their regulations and support the administration's reform goals.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and others who must follow federal regulations
who_it_affects.how: The rules they must follow could change if agencies revise or remove regulations under this order.
